\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Public Header Layout}]{ulsbs-songbook}
% Public synthetic titles only. Widths and indivisible title lengths deliberately
% straddle the header width. Each postlude targets the end of that song's body.
\newcommand{\HeaderCase}[5]{%
  \begingroup
    \setlength{\textwidth}{#1}
    \setlength{\hsize}{#1}
    \setlength{\linewidth}{#1}
    \renewcommand{\extendpostlude}{%
      \hypertarget{after-#2}{After song #2.}\quad
      \hyperlink{after-#2}{Return to the end of this song.}}
    \begin{songs}{}
      \beginsong{#3}[id={#2},#4]
        \beginverse
          #5
          Another plain lyric line.
        \endverse
      \endsong
    \end{songs}
  \endgroup
}
\begin{document}
\pagestyle{empty}
\HeaderCase{110mm}{wide-long}{GenericPlaceholderTitleWithoutAnyBreaksAcrossTheHeader}{}{Plain opening lyric.}
\HeaderCase{80mm}{medium-long}{UnbreakablePlaceholderHeadingAcrossTheColumn}{}{Plain opening lyric.}
\HeaderCase{55mm}{narrow-long}{SyntheticUnbrokenHeading}{}{Plain opening lyric.}
\HeaderCase{110mm}{wide-short}{Short Title}{}{Plain opening lyric.}
\HeaderCase{80mm}{medium-tagged}{Tagged Title}{ph={I}}{Plain opening lyric.}
\HeaderCase{110mm}{wide-chorded}{Chorded Title}{key={C},ph={II}}{\[C]Opening \[G]lyric.}
\HeaderCase{80mm}{medium-chorded}{Other Title}{key={G}}{\[G]Opening \[D]lyric.}
\end{document}
